title: cardputerzero-radio
summary: Internet radio with station search, favourites, sleep timer and alarm
description:
Stream internet radio on your CardputerZero.

Ships with a curated station list you can edit, plus live search across the
Radio Browser directory so you can find and save new stations on-device.

- Favourites, and scrolling track titles from stations that broadcast them
- Automatic reconnect when a stream drops
- Sleep timer, and a wake-to-radio alarm
- Record the live stream to the SD card
- Optional boot-to-radio autostart, toggled in Settings
- Tells you plainly when Wi-Fi is missing instead of blaming the station

Driven entirely from the keyboard. SPACE plays, arrows tune and set volume,
/ searches, G opens settings.

Requires an internet connection. Not yet tested on production hardware.
